parts.text: To + do 的构成 不定式 的否定 句形成分

rows: want to do 想去做什么
He wanted to buy a new car. 他本想买一辆新车。
want sb. to do 想要某人做什么
I want him to move his car. 我想让他移一下他的车。
tell sb. to do 告诉某人做什么
Tell him to go back right now.告诉他快点回来。
ask sb. to do 要求某人做什么
I asked Carol to help me with the assignment.我请卡罗尔帮我做作业。
I don’t want him to worry about me. 我不想让他担心。
Tell him not to come back . 跟他说不要回来了。
I asked him not to smoke in the house. 我请他不要在屋内吸烟。
主 + 谓 + 宾
He wants to buy a new car .
主 + 谓 + 宾 + 宾补
I want him to move his car .

parts.text: To Do 不定式的变化

rows: 指从一个地方到另一个地方携带或运输物品
You must carry ID at all times. 你必须随身携带身份证件。
指去某个地方取回某物，并带回原处
He went to fetch some books.他去取来了一些书。
指将某物从别处带到说话人所在的地方
All you need to bring are sheets. 你需要带的就是床单。
指将某物从说话人所在的地方带到别处，或者进行某种行为或活动
Take any necessary actions. / Take whatever action is needed . 采取任何必要的行动。

parts.text: Don't do! 直接命令 (Direct) 祈使句
I told him not to do. 间接转述(Indirect) 动词不定式

rows: I want you to carry it.
I don’t want you to hurt yourself.
He wants you to correct it.
She doesn’t want him to slip.
He wants us to listen to it.
Tell him not to fall. 动词不定式的否定形式
He wants me to describe it.
Tell him not to miss it. Tell + someone + not + to do something

parts.text: Warn him: "Warn him not to slip on the ice." (警告他不要在冰上滑倒。)
Remind him: "Remind him not to trip over the wires." (提醒他不要被电线绊倒。)
Advice: "Advise him against falling." (建议他别摔了 —— 虽然这种说法比较少见，但在正式文书里很有用。)
